summary: Large two bedroom apartment · Excellent Quayside location · Available now · Ideal for two sharers or a couple
description:
A spacious two bedroom Quayside apartment with views over the River Tyne.

My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the Lettings market this two bedroom apartment, situated at the popular Hanover Mill development on Newcastle's Quayside. A large open plan kitchen / living room with integrated appliances and private balcony. Two great size double bedrooms with an en-suite to master as well as a family bathroom. Secure allocated parking also available.

Close proximity to Newcastle's popular Quayside and City Centre providing easy access to a plethora of amenities as well as Newcastle Central Station.

Available now, furnished. To arrange a viewing, contact MPB today and speak with the Lettings Team.
